Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nThe tank is blocking the passage for the container.\nYou will need it later. Find some C4 to blow it up.
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n坦克挡住了容器的通道。\n你之后会用到它。找些C4炸掉它。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Military Police Guard:\nListen. I've got a bomb I've been working on in here.\nMaybe you can use it to take out that fancy tank out there.
Translation: 军警守卫：\n听着，我在这里一直在捣鼓一个炸弹。\n也许你可以用它来干掉外面那辆豪华坦克。

Title: NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):\nWatch out for the tower gunner ahead behind that gate!
Translation: 斯文·维京（无线电）：\n小心前方大门后面的塔楼枪手！

Title: NETMESSAGE:DANGER!\n\nThe bomb has been planted! TAKE COVER!!
Translation: 危险！\n\n炸弹已安置！快找掩护！！

Title: NETMESSAGE:ITEM UPDATE\n\nYour team has picked up a powerful homemade nitro bomb.
Translation: 物品更新\n\n你的队伍捡到了一个强力自制硝基炸弹。

Title:
NETMESSAGE:Sven Viking (radio):
To destroy the anti-air batteries around the sector, and gain an advantage over
the enemy fortifications, you are to flood the entire place by destroying the dam.
Find a way inside.
Translation: 要摧毁区域周围的防空炮台，并获取对敌人的优势\n通过防御工事，你需要通过摧毁水坝来淹没整个地方。\n找一条路进去。
